thread:
Sam: quick share — ran a pocketcache threshold sweep across H100/us-east and A100/eu-west with our new seqlen mixes. TL;DR: hitrate vs p99 tradeoff is sharper on H100 when pocket_threshold < 6.
Anya: nice. what's pocket_threshold again?
Sam: it's our lightweight prefetch window parameter — number of KV entries we keep in L2 before triggering aggressive prefetch. default was 8.
Sam: sweep params: 
```
models: redwood-7b-q4_0
seqlen_mixes: [short:70%, med:20%, long:10%]
batch: 8
kernels: [cutlass_fused_attn, triton_blocked]
gpus: [H100_us_east, A100_eu_west]
pocket_threshold: [2,4,6,8,12]
metrics: [cache_hitrate, p50_tok_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, throughput_rps]
```
Miguel: did you include kv paging on/off?
Sam: yes — two runs each. paging enabled shows ~7-12% hitrate drop at low threshold.
Zara: can you paste the summary table?
Sam: pasted below. numbers are averaged over 1h steady-state synthetic workload.
```
H100_us_east (paging ON)
threshold  hit%   p50_ms  p95_ms  p99_ms  rps
2          45.2   6.2     28.3    73.1    680
4          58.9   5.1     22.8    52.7    720
6          67.0   4.6     18.2    38.5    760
8          72.4   4.3     16.1    32.2    780
12         75.1   4.1     15.3    30.0    790

A100_eu_west (paging ON)
threshold  hit%   p50_ms  p95_ms  p99_ms  rps
2          42.8   7.8     35.4    95.2    520
4          55.0   6.4     27.0    68.8    560
6          63.3   5.7     22.1    48.9    600
8          69.0   5.2     19.0    40.0    620
12         71.6   5.0     18.0    37.8    630
```
Sam: paging OFF numbers are ~+6-8% hit for low thresholds but p50 improves less vs H100, p99 still better on H100.
Anya: so H100 has steeper latency gains per hit% — kernel choice?
Sam: yup. cutlass_fused_attn on H100 gives ~8% extra throughput vs triton_blocked at thresholds >=6. For low thresholds the overhead dominates so gains shrink.
Miguel: any quantization impact? q4_0 here. did we try q5/x8?
Sam: ran q5_int8 on a subset: hit% similar (<1% delta) but p95/p99 slightly worse (~+6-9ms) due to dequant path overhead.
Zara: capacity sizing notes? recommended slots/gpu?
Sam: with threshold=6 and H100, we can provision 760 rps per GPU (for this model/mix) with 10% safety buffer -> ~680 useful rps. A100 ~600 -> ~540 useful rps.
Anya: any regional variance beyond raw hw? network hop etc?
Sam: minor — eu-west experienced 2-3ms extra p50 due to cross-zone egress in our test cluster. negligible for p99 differences.
Miguel: did you capture tail traces for failures or stall patterns?
Sam: yes — added a short stacktrace snippet where eviction+paging collided:
```
[evict] async_pager: stalled_on_lock 120ms
[kv] lookup: miss -> trigger_prefetch (window=3)
[kernel] fused_attn launch queue spike
```
Sam: that pattern appears mostly at threshold=2 with paging ON on A100.
Zara: actionable takeaways?
Sam: 1) set pocket_threshold=6 as default for redwood-7b-q4_0 for mixed seqlen workloads.
Sam: 2) H100 + cutlass_fused gives best p99 & throughput; if cost-constrained A100 still OK but increase threshold to 8 for similar p99.
Sam: 3) avoid q5/int8 for latency-sensitive p99 until dequant path optimized.
Sam: 4) enable light prefix caching (tier-0) to raise hit by ~3-4% if paging ON.
Anya: can you add these to the onboarding checklist and attach perf dashboard?
Sam: will do — pushing a dashboard now.
deploy-bot: dashboard deployed: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/kv/pocket-threshold-sweep-1745003210
Miguel: awesome. next step: run with real traffic trace from prod for 6h and compare. I'll own that.
Sam: thanks — assign to Miguel. I'll update the model-onboard doc with defaults. :thumbsup:
